Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity:

 

 

Technical Operations in Ontario is hiring for our Civil Specialist role in Southern Ontario, covering the area from Windsor/Sarnia to Niagara Falls.  This individual will coordinate the maintenance of our regional infrastructure and support third-party contractors as they complete the work.  

 

What you’ll do:

  • Coordinate the maintenance of the civil portion of our wireless infrastructure, including roads, compounds, shelters, electrical systems, HVAC systems, and landscaping.
  • Coordinate the relocation of equipment or antennas with landlords.
  • Collaborate with procurement on service requests for proposals and source job-specific quotes from our third-party contractors.
  • Open and close purchase orders, process invoices for payment, and participate in budget planning.
  • Provide on-site mentoring, monitoring, and training to third-party contractors.
  • Conduct quality inspections, both on-site and remotely, to ensure work is complete and meets Rogers' standards.
  • Assist in coordinating and responding to emergencies, both on-site and remotely. 

 

What you bring: 

  • Must have a valid Ontario driver's licence in good standing.
  • Effective communicator, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Superior organization and interpersonal skills required.
  • Technically proficient with the desire to learn.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Related post-secondary education, such as a civil engineering technologist/technician or related on-the-job experience.
  • Experience in project planning and management would be an asset.

  • Discounts: Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
